top3.name: MULTI_HORIZON_TREND_AGREEMENT_AS_REGIME_FEATURE
top3.WHY_IT_SURVIVES: Coinbase independently observes monotonic 20d forward returns as 30/90/365d trend horizons agree; Howden-Andreev supply fixed-lookback walk-forward and explicit cost sensitivity.
top3.WHY_IT_MIGHT_FAIL: Evidence is daily/multi-day, not 1h; Coinbase whole-framework OOS is not documented and the 30d optimum is explicitly fragile.
MISSING_DATA: none for simple trailing-return agreement; enough warm-up history must exist
top3.MINIMUM_ATOMIC_TEST: Do not alter raw score. Pre-register 0/1/2/3 positive trailing BTC returns at 30d/90d/365d as a regime tag, then evaluate the existing frozen SENEX 1h score across future all-opportunity observations by tag. No threshold fitting and no exposure change.
top3.PRIMARY_METRIC: Difference in frozen-score 1h discrimination/calibration across pre-registered trend-agreement strata; descriptive until prospective N accrues.
top3.FALSIFIER: No ordered improvement/stability across trend-agreement strata, or effect reverses out of sample.
top3.REQUIRED_N_HORIZON: 365d warm-up plus every prospective all-opportunity 1h label thereafter; source does not justify an invented fixed promotion N. Keep 20d source result as external context, not SENEX target.

top3.name: PERP_MICROSTRUCTURE_STATE_FUNDING_OI_ORDERFLOW
top3.WHY_IT_SURVIVES: SENEX already persists funding/OI/order-flow/book signals; Glassnode documents rapid CVD/funding/OI regime reversals and perp-return research repeatedly identifies basis/price-volume/funding drivers.
top3.WHY_IT_MIGHT_FAIL: Perp factor evidence is cross-sectional/multi-asset and accessible 2026 paper does not show a sufficient OOS/multiple-testing protocol for 1h; turnover costs could erase signal.
MISSING_DATA: canonical CVD definition if separate from existing orderflow
venue-consistent fee/slippage model for any later trading test
top3.MINIMUM_ATOMIC_TEST: With all existing feature transforms frozen, test each raw signed/ranked pre-decision microstructure field individually against future 1h direction on a chronological holdout; no combinations, thresholds or feature selection in the first test.
top3.PRIMARY_METRIC: Holdout ROC-AUC/Spearman rank association per preregistered raw field, with turnover/cost reporting before any strategy claim.
top3.FALSIFIER: All preregistered fields are indistinguishable from null or sign-unstable on holdout, or any apparent effect disappears net of conservative costs.
top3.REQUIRED_N_HORIZON: All prospective 1h opportunities in a preregistered chronological holdout; no numeric promotion N is supplied by external sources, so none is invented here.

top3.name: SEMIVOLATILITY_STATE_AS_RISK_CONTROL
top3.WHY_IT_SURVIVES: Fresh BTC-specific research finds upside- and downside-driven volatility states are economically different; this directly challenges symmetric volatility brakes and is isolated from direction prediction.
top3.WHY_IT_MIGHT_FAIL: Accessible evidence does not establish 15m/1h transfer, transaction costs or explicit OOS split; effect may be daily-horizon only.
SENEX_DATA_ALREADY_PRESENT: BTC OHLC/returns sufficient to derive upside/downside realized semivolatility in a future isolated research module
MISSING_DATA: paper-exact lookback/horizon and code semantics must be recovered before any implementation
no semivolatility field currently frozen in decision audit
top3.MINIMUM_ATOMIC_TEST: First recover paper-exact timing semantics. Then, in PAPER-only research, compare frozen SENEX outcomes across pre-decision upside-vs-downside semivolatility states without changing candidate direction or thresholds.
top3.PRIMARY_METRIC: Out-of-sample risk-control utility: drawdown/variance change conditional on unchanged directional decisions; return impact secondary.
top3.FALSIFIER: No OOS risk reduction at unchanged candidate logic, or any benefit requires horizon/threshold tuning not preregistered from source.
top3.REQUIRED_N_HORIZON: UNRESOLVED_FROM_ACCESSIBLE_SOURCE; no 1h N/horizon is invented. Candidate cannot advance beyond protocol design until exact source timing is recovered.
